name: Svelte Shadcn Blocks
summary: 150+ free marketing and UI blocks for Svelte 5 across Normal, Mist and Veil variants, built on shadcn-svelte.
description: Production-ready landing page blocks based on shadcn-svelte and Tailwind CSS, inspired by Tailark: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, stats, call to action, footer, team, contact, signup and more. Three design variants (Normal, Mist, Veil) work in light and dark mode; blocks install via the shadcn-svelte registry or the jsrepo CLI.
